rules: keyFn of wma0.3-screenshot/dashboard/engine.js lines 16-34; a bucket is a bar only if a day in it has a daily bar; o = first daily open, h = max, l = min, c = last daily close; bar start = first calendar day of the bucket; compared buckets ended by the last closed day; genuine = also differs from bars rebuilt from the reference 1D (fresh TradingView 1D in part 1, tv-history 1D in part 2), revision = only the stored daily data differs, referenceOnly = differs from the reference rebuild only. Records: tv = TradingView's bar, rebuilt = from the stored daily data, reference = from the reference 1D, relDiff = (tv - rebuilt) / |rebuilt| (tv vs reference for referenceOnly); small = |relDiff| < 1e-6
